llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern about live posting, scheduling, commenting, reacting, and deleting is valid user guidance, but these actions are disclosed, purpose-aligned, and shown as examples rather than hidden automatic behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The analytics concern is purpose-aligned because the skill clearly uses Publora API endpoints for LinkedIn metrics; users should still treat account and post metrics as potentially sensitive business data.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help operate LinkedIn through Publora. Store the Publora API key securely, use the least-privileged connected account practical, and require explicit confirmation of account, content, target post/comment/reaction, deletion target, and scheduled time before any mutating request is made.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward Publora LinkedIn API guide, but it can perform real LinkedIn posting, commenting, reacting, scheduling, and deletion actions.
